prompt:
Create a production sprite-family sheet derived from the existing reference atlas, for the ONE rachni soldier at bottom-row second column of the reference only. This is a new set of fixed poses for the existing ME1 prototype identity, not an original-game fidelity certificate.

PURPOSE: transparent HD 2D sprites in an orthographic Three.js JRPG battle scene. Preserve the reference's insect-like rachni body: pale beige/ivory chitin plates with worn red-brown seams, broad angular horned/crowned carapace, dark recessed mandibles and narrow greenish organic underparts, long thin angular legs and hooked forelimbs in the same anatomical arrangement as the reference. Preserve one coherent species, appendage count and shell design across all four poses. It must remain an alien arthropod, never humanoid. No hands holding guns, no human arms, no armour suit added.

VIEW: fixed front-left three-quarter angle facing screen-left, with slight downward orthographic view, same soft above-left lighting and detailed prerendered material rendering as the reference. The entire shell, all legs and any long appendage must fit. Use the same native pixel scale across all drawings.

OUTPUT: ONE native 1536 by 1024 RGBA image with truly transparent background, four complete isolated drawings on a spacious 2 by 2 sheet. Each subject should fit within its own 768 by 512 region with generous 35-pixel transparent clearance to outer edges and to other poses. No silhouettes or appendages may overlap between regions. No ground, shadow puddle, halo, gradient background, fog or checkerboard.

Top-left: aim/alert stance: the same soldier crouched and ready, balanced on its legs, mandibles closed, limbs all attached.
Top-right: power/action: a distinct forward acid-spit preparation gesture, mandibles open and body leaning forward, one forelimb slightly raised. The acid action is only implied by posture; do NOT draw acid, bubbles, droplets, a projectile, beam or cloud.
Bottom-left: hit: recoil backwards and lower its body while retaining the same shell and limb arrangement, all feet still visible, no gore.
Bottom-right: down: the same whole rachni curled on its side in a clear defeated pose, legs folded inward, complete shell and all appendages contained in the region; no severed parts or gore.

EXCLUDE: text, labels, borders, inset pictures, extra creatures, human traits, weapons, invented powers, energy effects, scenery, cropped legs, cut shell tips or disconnected appendages. These are four fixed key drawings, not a motion cycle.
fidelityClaim: Existing prototype identity only; original-game anatomy, costume and equipment are not certified1:1.
